cards.notes: Class-wide: printed numbers are 'G 0175' to 'G 0204' (recorded without the G). Condition icons identified by colour/shape: yellow diamond with a circle and triangle = Bless (checked against Tinkerer 'Chimeric Formula', where GHS lists strengthen, bless in the same order as the blue arm and yellow icon); pink diamond with a flame-edged shield = Ward (same shape as the Ward icon on the Sunkeeper perk sheet, GHS custom perk 4); blue arm = Strengthen; brown diamond with '?' = Muddle; dark blue starburst diamond = Stun. Light element = yellow sun-star circle; consume = red X on the element.

mechanics: Light economy: most cards infuse Light (mandatory '!' infusion boxes) and many consume it for a bonus; Daybreak top consumes Dark and infuses Light
Consume Light grants advantage on the attack (Hammer Blow, Holy Strike, Burning Flash, Path of Glory tops)

Grant abilities: an ally performs a printed ability (Empowering Command bottom, Tactical Order top, Mobilizing Axiom bottom incl. self, Arresting March both halves, Divine Intervention bottom incl. self, Illuminate the Target bottom, Supportive Chant top with conditions on 'self'); Arresting March consume Light heals 'the target of the grant ability'
Recover cards for allies: from the lost pile (Brilliant Prayer top, Bright Aegis bottom), from the discard pile (Soothing Light top level 1 only, Solar Bastion top)
Unrecoverable icon on lost halves (Brilliant Prayer top, Bright Aegis bottom)
Extra turn for an ally: play up to two cards, one top + one bottom action (Bright Aegis bottom consume Light)
Heal X = target's maximum HP (Lay On Hands top); heal 'target all' with and without range (Engulfing Radiance, Holy Defense, Solar Bastion)

Use-slot persistents: Retaliate 3 vs adjacent attackers (Purifying Aura top, 5), +1/+2 Attack on allies' attacks with Ward bonus (Sanctify top, 3, not lost), single-target heals spread to allies within 2 of the primary target (Beacon of Light top, 3), Flying + +4 Attack and advantage on melee attack abilities (Divine Ascension top, 5)

Round effects: negate all damage to you and adjacent allies (Protective Blessing bottom), attacks on you gain disadvantage (Daybreak bottom), attacks on you and allies within 4 gain disadvantage (Engulfing Radiance bottom), all allies +1 Attack and optional advantage (Supportive Chant bottom), enemies' positive and 2x modifiers become +0 (Divine Intervention bottom)

Untimed persistents: reduce Pierce against you by 2 with a mandatory -1 Move on your move abilities (Defensive Stance bottom), take damage for allies (Divine Intervention top), Retaliate 2 (Scales of Justice top), consume Light during an attack ability -> +1 Attack, Pierce 1, Null becomes 2x (Scales of Justice bottom)
Designated-hex attack plus Strengthen on allies adjacent to you or that hex (Illuminate the Target top)
Conditions on allies/self: Bless, Strengthen, Ward; on enemies: Muddle, Stun (Stun also as a standalone ability, Dazzling Charge bottom); XP 1 per enemy targeted (Burning Flash top); no summons
unclear: Heal 'target all' (Engulfing Radiance top: no range printed; Holy Defense bottom: range 1; Solar Bastion top: range 3): whether 'all' includes yourself and, for Engulfing Radiance, what range applies is a rules question; the cards print only 'all' (Righteous Strength and Purifying Aura print 'all allies')

Illuminate the Target top: 'Designate an adjacent hex containing an enemy to perform:' reads as if the abilities are performed from/at the designated hex; the attack targets the enemy in it and Strengthen targets allies adjacent to you or to that hex. Whether the attack counts as melee or ranged is a rules question

Supportive Chant top: the grant prints 'all allies within Range 3' without 'and self' (unlike Mobilizing Axiom and Divine Intervention), and the 'self' pill sits after the conditions inside the grant; read as each ally giving itself Ward, Strengthen, Bless. Not decided whether the Sunkeeper is included
Scales of Justice top: Retaliate 2 with the persistent icon and no slots or round icon, i.e. a permanent Retaliate 2 until the end of the scenario; read as printed

Use-slot tracks (Purifying Aura, Sanctify, Beacon of Light, Divine Ascension): the small red slash marks after the last slot appear on Sanctify too, whose corner has no lost icon; fate taken from the corner icons (Sanctify discarded, the others lost)
